entities.summary: Gareth Anscombe is a rugby union player who plays for Top 14 side Bayonne and the Wales national rugby union team. He primarily plays at fly-half but can also play as a fullback. Anscombe is the son of former Auckland and Ulster coach Mark Anscombe.
